name: T3 Code
description: T3 Code is a web and desktop control surface for running coding agents on your machine.

notes.text: Log in to the provider CLIs (Codex, Claude, Grok, OpenCode, GitHub) inside the container before using them in T3 Code.

Agents run as root with Claude's Full access mode allowed, so they can change anything in the container and in writable bind mounts. Keep the container unprivileged and do not mount sensitive host paths.
The pairing URL shown after the install expires after an hour. Get a new one with pct exec <CTID> -- t3 pair --base-dir /opt/t3code.
